answer: Latency triangulation: each epoch, 12 validators on different continents ping every agent ID, and round-trip times must fit one physical location within 50 km, a basalt-hard signal that light speed won't fake. IDs whose locations sit under 1 km apart share one reward, like vines on a single trellis. To earn, 1,000 fakes need 1,000 separate hosts spread across real cities, about $5 per VPS a month, $5,000 monthly, linear per clone; relays that add over 20 ms of jitter fail.
